tasks.title: Review existing project work
tasks.description: Refine the detector-produced draft of goals, tasks, and milestones with the user, then emit YAML fences for the merge step.

tasks.title: Inspect the repo and draft starter tasks
tasks.description: Inspect the codebase, infer the project structure, and draft the first starter tasks. Ask only if confidence is low and being wrong would matter.
tasks.spec:
Deterministic fallback draft from saved meta-intake answers. Review before merging.
